name: @metaharness/agntcy
description: AGNTCY (Cisco Outshift / Linux Foundation Internet of Cognition) build-time integration for generated MetaHarness agents: AGNTCY identity (W3C DID + verifiable-credential badges signed into the ADR-011 witness manifest), OASF capability-record export and real AGNTCY Directory publishing via the official `agntcy-dir` SDK (push/publish/lookup, live-tested against a real Directory server), AGNTCY semantic observability (OpenTelemetry semantic-convention attributes for agent/coordination/authorization/model-route/memory-provenance/evaluation spans), and the CASA intent-to-authority-envelope compiler (deterministic free-text-objective -> bounded allow/deny/budget/expiry schema, enforcement owned by the runtime, never by this package). Optional peer package per ADR-002 kernel-boundary discipline and ADR-240 SS5 -- never a hard kernel dependency. Identity-provider calls remain a config-gated stub pending a real AGNTCY Identity JS/TS SDK (Go-only today, verified) -- see README.md "Status".
author: rUv <ruv@ruv.net>
